statement: Within each domain's frozen Panel-3 NEAR/FAR pair, the NEAR genome will have a higher fraction of recovered MOP tokens whose exact 16-nt implementations were previously observed in the pre-Panel-3 same-domain training union.
primary_statistic: three domain-wise directional contrasts in Q_g literal-reuse fraction
support_condition: SUPPORTED_DIRECTIONAL if all 3 domain contrasts have Q_NEAR > Q_FAR.
weakening_condition: MIXED if exactly 2 of 3 domain contrasts have Q_NEAR > Q_FAR.
falsification_condition: FALSIFIED_DIRECTIONAL if 0 or 1 of 3 domain contrasts have Q_NEAR > Q_FAR.
contamination_boundary: Generated from v0.0.48 retrospective implementation-depth result and frozen before Panel-3 sequence acquisition.
